sourceEnglishObjective: Close an unfinished work area before departure
sourceEnglishSpeaking: Explain which section needs a tarp and have the crew repeat the plan.
candidateObjective: 帰る前に未完成の屋根部分を示し、養生の段取りを作業班に伝える。
candidateFocus: ～前に places an action before departure; ～ない部分 identifies unfinished work. ～たら expresses a change in conditions, and ～てください gives a direct crew instruction.

archivedSpeaking.opening: 裏側の未完成部分に養生シートを掛けてください。段取りを繰り返して確認しましょう。
archivedSpeaking.goal: Explain which section needs a tarp and have the crew repeat the plan.

curriculumAdaptationNote: Preserve the exact nine-turn 4:00 windy scene: forecast rain tonight, unfinished rear section, open deck at risk, cover before leaving, tarp unfinished work, tie tarp with rope, stop work and come down if conditions change, and repeat the plan. The source teaches conditional commands for this scene, not a universal roof-weather threshold. Resolve structural deck, tarp securement and safe weather egress with qualified Japanese/roofing reviewers before selecting scored answers. Archived Japanese, forms and speaking are evidence only; this packet creates no learner, audio, score or saved-progress identity.

cards.sourceSpanish: Cubran con lona lo que no terminen hoy.
cards.sourceEnglish: Tarp anything you can't finish today.
cards.archivedJapanese: 今日終えられない部分には養生シートを掛けてください。
cards.archivedEnglish: Tarp anything you can't finish today.
cards.reviewNote: The source directs tarping anything unfinished today in this weather scene. Confirm the job-specific work scope and safe method; archived 養生シート may not convey a secured weather tarp in every roofing context.

cards.sourceSpanish: Detengan el trabajo y bajen si cambia el tiempo.
cards.sourceEnglish: Stop work and come down if the weather changes.
cards.archivedJapanese: 天候が変わったら作業を止めて屋根から下りてください。
cards.archivedEnglish: Stop work and come down if the weather changes.
cards.reviewNote: The source commands stopping work and coming down if weather changes. The real decision depends on site weather/egress/fall-protection plan; do not convert this into a universal threshold or imply descending during unsafe conditions is always safe.

cards.sourceSpanish: Cubran esta sección antes de irnos.
cards.sourceEnglish: Cover this section before we leave.
cards.archivedJapanese: 帰る前にこの部分を覆ってください。
cards.archivedEnglish: Cover this section before we leave.
cards.reviewNote: Cover this section before leaving refers to the unfinished rear area; qualified safety review must check that it can be covered safely in current wind.

cards.archivedJapanese: 養生シートをしっかり固定してください。
cards.reviewNote: Tie down the tarp well is a rope-securement action; archived 固定してください omits tying and may imply an unspecified fastening method. Align with Reader 7.

cards.candidateJapanese: 確認のため、段取りを繰り返してください。

reader.archivedEnglish: Rain can wet the open deck.
reader.reviewNote: Open deck is the exposed structural deck, not generic underlayment. Archived 屋根下地 needs a trade-term decision before weather/damage claim is selected.

reader.sourceSpanish: Cubran esta sección antes de irnos.

reader.reviewNote: The rear unfinished section must be covered before departure; ensure the Japanese line stays inside the scene's safe work plan and does not become generic roofing advice.

reader.sourceSpanish: Cubran con lona lo que no terminen hoy.

reader.reviewNote: Amarren with rope explicitly means tie down. Archived 固定 may not preserve the rope action or adequate securement, and wind makes safety context important.
